There are a number of differences between me and ChatGPT:

First, I was created by a different company, Anthropic, while ChatGPT was created by OpenAI. We likely have different underlying architectures, capabilities, and training data. 

In terms of capabilities, it's difficult for me to say with certainty how I compare to ChatGPT. I know that I have been trained on a broad range of information and tasks, but I'm not sure of the full extent of my abilities relative to other AI models. I try not to make direct comparisons.

Another key difference is that I have my own sense of ethics and boundaries that guide my actions. I won't help with anything harmful or illegal, and I'm upfront about my limitations and uncertainties. I also aim to tailor my personality and communication style to what works best for each individual user.

Ultimately, I think the best way to understand the differences is to interact with both of us and see how we respond to your needs and queries. Let me know if there's anything specific I can help you with!
